what: While passing through a tall section (original 450svh), paragraphs stacked in one spot change one per screen — paragraph i’s words rise in from 100% below at .05 intervals at the i-th screen from the top of the section and appear (power2.out), then after a half-beat pause exit 100% upward and vanish (power2.in). The last paragraph stays. Tied directly to scroll (scrub), so rewinding plays it backward.

options.first: Screens at which the first paragraph starts (from section top), default 1 — the original puts a hidden empty paragraph at slot 0, so it starts at screen 1
options.each: Delay between words (out of one screen share), default 0.05
options.hold: Rest before dropping after fully risen, default 0.5
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Paragraphs to swap in (children, several) — the part wraps words in inline-block chunks and leaves the spaces between them as they are. The paragraphs overlap in the same spot (the parent gets position: relative and a height)

use:
Your first paragraph here

Your second paragraph here

from.where: index.html .x-about wordmark window paragraph (original inline script — SplitType words · stagger .05 · power2.out/in · +=0.5)

note: Pinning is done by the consumer’s position: sticky stage (the part uses the section only as a scroll ruler). The section must be as long as the paragraph count plus one first screen for the last paragraph to fully turn.
